sentences.japanese: 君はお姉さんほど早く起きないんだね。
sentences.english: You don't get up as early as your sister.

sentences.japanese: 君の姉さんはテレビで相撲を見て楽しんでいるのですね。
sentences.english: Your sister enjoys watching sumo wrestling on TV.

sentences.japanese: 君の姉さん、相変わらず美人だね。
sentences.english: Your sister's as beautiful as ever.

sentences.japanese: 君のお姉さんは王女のように上品な顔をしている。
sentences.english: Your sister looks as noble as if she were a princess.

sentences.japanese: 去る６月に私の姉は高校の教師と結婚した。
sentences.english: My sister married a high school teacher last June.
